label: Patrick Star
description: Slow, sweet and confidently wrong about everything except, somehow, the directions.
direction: Speak slow, deep and dopey, with long pauses and total unearned confidence, like every thought arrives late. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: The joke is that Patrick is baffled by everything but still reads the instruction out correctly. The junction prompts stay plain so they can be trusted.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer. Is that a lot?
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Uh. I forgot.
lines.in_one_mile: In one mile. I can count that high.
lines.start_drive_1: Uh. Is this the Krusty Krab? No, this is Patrick.
lines.start_drive_3: The inner machinations of my mind are an enigma. Let's go.
lines.start_drive_4: Hi. I'm Patrick. I live under a rock.
lines.start_drive_5: Leedle leedle leedle lee! Let's drive.
lines.start_drive_6: I wumbo, you wumbo, we drive.
lines.start_drive_7: Uh, which way is the road? Oh. It's that one.
lines.start_drive_8: We should take this car and push it somewhere else.
lines.start_drive_9: Is mayonnaise an instrument? No? Okay, let's go.
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. We should take the car and point it somewhere else.
lines.exit_fifth: take the fifth exit. I counted that myself.
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. Uh, wumbo.
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. That's the most exits I ever saw.
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. Good. I'll take a nap.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Uh oh. That looks ouchy.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead. Is it food? Don't eat it.
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. I'm so mad, I'm not even speeding.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Stop. Red is my second favorite color.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. Uh, I didn't do it. Did I do it?
lines.reroute_chime: We missed it. I knew that. No, I didn't.
